title: 21.12. Saññojanādichagocchaka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasaññojanaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Naganthaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā gantho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Naoghaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā ogho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nayogaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā yogo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Nanīvaraṇaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Naparāmāsaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
